response.original_title: Disney+ Insider: National Geographic Museum of Exploration
response.overview: Step inside the National Geographic Museum of Exploration with National Geographic Explorer Andrés Ruzo alongside “Descendants: Wicked Wonderland” actress Kiara Romero. Disney+ Insider unveils a space designed to spark curiosity and inspire discovery. From the museum’s striking, canyon-inspired architecture to its four thematic areas—Spark, Trek, Purpose, and Impact—each experience highlights the power of exploration. Along the way, rare artifacts, hands-on interactive spaces, and immersive exhibitions bring science, storytelling, and conservation to life. The experience builds to a powerful invitation: to see the world differently, embrace an Explorer’s mindset, and step into a future shaped by curiosity, wonder, and purpose.
